verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for a data-pipeline platform, but nothing in the evidence documents retention settings, purge or deletion controls, or data-lifecycle policies. CDC docs only describe reading DELETE records from source logs for replication, which is an adjacent feature rather than user control over retention. The community item about hard deletions is an open question, not evidence of the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
